article.title: Open AI says Iranian regime used ChatGPT to create fake articles
paras: Editor's note: this story was translated from the original VOA Persian article.

Iranian regime agents have used OpenAI’s super intelligence tool to create fake articles criticizing the U.S. war against the terror regime and succeeded in getting them published in international news outlets, the U.S. tech company reported on Thursday, October 8.

In its online report, OpenAI said it found that the Iranian covert influence operation used its ChatGPT tool to create seven fake Western journalist personas and then used those personas to pitch the SI/AI-generated articles to the outlets. It said OpenAI investigators identified almost 100 articles published under those fake bylines in 12 media small-to-medium sized news outlets from July 2025 to September.

OpenAI said it blocked the ChatGPT accounts that the Iranian agents used to create those articles. It said the influence operation also generated positive social media comments on the fake articles to make them appear popular.

OpenAI said the fake articles were published with headlines including: "Trump’s Iran Gamble Hardened the Regime it was Meant to Break”, "Is America’s Iran Policy Being Privatized? A Question for Jared Kushner", and "Why Trump Blinked on Iran."

This incident is the latest example of advanced SI/AI tools playing a role in the Iranian regime’s propaganda war against the U.S. and Israel, which launched a joint offensive in February to stop the regime’s nuclear weapons program and other threatening activities.

None of the media outlets that published the OpenAI-identified fake articles appear to be mainstream news organizations. But some have significant online audiences; for instance, the London-based news site Middle East Monitor has nearly two million followers on Facebook.

Middle East Monitor's Editor-in-Chief Dawoud Abdullah told CNN he would review the articles identified by OpenAI and "take appropriate action." Another representative of the outlet later told CNN that the articles had been taken down and said the publication was reviewing its submissions process.
zh: OpenAI 表示，伊朗政權利用 ChatGPT 製作假新聞
編者註：本報導翻譯自美國之音波斯語版原文。
美國科技公司於10月8日（星期四）報導指出，伊朗政權的特工利用OpenAI的超級智慧工具，製作了批評美國對抗恐怖政權戰爭的虛假文章，並成功讓這些文章刊登於國際新聞媒體上。
OpenAI 在其線上報告中指出，該公司發現這項伊朗的隱蔽影響行動利用其 ChatGPT 工具，創建了七個虛假的西方記者身分，並藉此向各媒體機構推銷由 SI/AI 生成的文章。 該報告指出，OpenAI 調查人員確認，自 2025 年 7 月至 9 月期間，共有近 100 篇文章以這些虛假署名發表於 12 家中小型媒體機構。
OpenAI 表示，已封鎖伊朗特工用來撰寫這些文章的 ChatGPT 帳號。該公司指出，這項影響行動還針對這些假新聞在社群媒體上發布正面評論，使其看似廣受歡迎。
OpenAI 表示，這些假新聞的標題包括：「川普對伊朗的賭注反而鞏固了原本意圖推翻的政權」、「美國的伊朗政策是否正在被私有化？給賈里德·庫什納的一個問題」，以及「為何川普在伊朗問題上退縮了」。
這起事件是先進的網路情報（SI）與人工智慧（AI）工具在伊朗政權針對美國與以色列的宣傳戰中發揮作用的最新例證；美國與以色列曾於二月發動聯合攻勢，旨在阻止該政權的核武計畫及其他具威脅性的活動。
似乎沒有任何一家刊載了 OpenAI 識別出的假新聞的媒體機構屬於主流新聞組織。但其中部分媒體在網路上擁有龐大的受眾群；例如，總部位於倫敦的新聞網站「中東監察」（Middle East Monitor）在 Facebook 上擁有近兩百萬名追蹤者。
《中東監察報》（Middle East Monitor）總編輯達烏德·阿卜杜拉（Dawoud Abdullah）向美國有線電視新聞網（CNN）表示，他將審查 OpenAI 標示出的文章，並「採取適當行動」。該媒體的另一位代表稍後向 CNN 表示，相關文章已遭下架，並稱該刊正重新檢視其稿件審核流程。
